newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Pacific sets terms on loan issue.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Pacific sets terms on loan issue.

text.p: Citic Pacific's HK$3.8 billion loan facility is in general syndication, arranger Chase Manhattan Asia said on Monday.
The facility is composed of two tranches.

Tranche A of HK$2.942 billion is available in Hong Kong or U.S. dollars at the option of borrower. The facility, which is structured as a 24-month revolving credit converting to a term loan, has a final maturity of seven years with a put option in year five.
Tranche B of US$110 million is available in U.S dollars only and has a final maturity of seven years and has an availability period of six months.

Tranche A pays an interest margin of 60 basis points per annum from year one to year five and 70 basis points from year six to seven, while tranche B carries an interest margin of 67.5 basis points throughout the life of facility.
Fees for co-arrangers committing HK$120 million are 55 basis points for tranche A and 66 basis points for tranche B.
Fees for co-lead managers committing HK$80 million are 50 basis points for tranche A and 59 basis points for tranche B.
Fees for senior managers committing HK$50 million are 45 basis points for tranche A and 52 basis points for tranche B.
